headline: AI blamed for 116,175 US job cuts this year
body: A quiet day of small items. Challenger counted 116,175 AI-attributed US job cuts so far in 2026, about 22% of the total, a dent in Shared Prosperity. The Justice Department backed OpenAI's fair-use defence in the NYT case, a nudge toward Power Concentration, and an AI-drafted Texas police report on a licence-plate camera search added to Surveillance & Control. Horizon Balance slipped to -4.86.
movers_note: Only small moves: 1984 +0.1, helped by the Axon report (+0.04), and Egalitarian Utopia -0.1, from the Challenger job-cut count (-0.04) and DOJ filing (-0.04).
